Week 1 2024
```{r}
offensive_summary_week1_2024 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Offense /Week 1/Week 1 Offensive Summary 2024.csv")
offensive_Passing_week1_2024 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Offense /Week 1/Week 1 Passing 2024.csv")
offensive_Rushing_week1_2024 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Offense /Week 1/Week 1 Rushing 2024.csv")
offensive_Receiving_week1_2024 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Offense /Week 1/Week 1 Receiving 2024.csv")
offensive_line_week1_2024 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Offense /Week 1/Week 1 Offensive Line 2024.csv")

colnames(offensive_summary_week1_2024)
colnames(offensive_Receiving_week1_2024)

# --- Week 1 2024 QB Data Preparation ---

cat("Passing dataset columns:\n")
print(colnames(offensive_Passing_week1_2024))

cat("\nRushing dataset columns:\n")
print(colnames(offensive_Rushing_week1_2024))

# --- Passing data ---
passing_clean <- offensive_Passing_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB") %>%
  mutate(
    Conference_Level = case_when(
      Conference %in% c("ACC", "Big 12", "Big Ten", "SEC", "Pac-12") ~ "P4",
      Conference %in% c("MAC", "The American", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)") ~ "G5",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Conference_Level %in% c("P4", "G5"))

# --- Rushing data ---
rushing_clean <- offensive_Rushing_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB") %>%
  select(Name, Position, 
         Rush.Grade, Rush.Yards, Yards.per.Attempt, Rush.Touchdowns, 
         First.Down.Runs, Fumbles, Fumbles.Lost, Missed.Tackles.on.Runs,
         Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt, Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt,
         Scrambles, First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage,
         Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt, Explosive.Runs, Change.of.direction.percentage)

# --- Offensive Summary (Snaps) ---
summary_clean <- offensive_summary_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# --- Join (ONLY Name + Position) ---
qb_combined_week1_2024 <- passing_clean %>%
  left_join(rushing_clean, by = c("Name", "Position")) %>%
  left_join(summary_clean, by = c("Name", "Position")) %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Season, Position, Conference, Conference_Level, Offensive.Snaps,
    
    # Passing
    Pass.Grade, Dropbacks, Attempts, Completion, Completion.Percentage,
    Adjusted.Completion.Percentage, Passing.Yards, 
    Yards.per.Attempt.x, 
    Yards.After.Catch.per.Completion.Percentage, Passing.Touchdowns,
    Interceptions, Sacks, Average.Time.to.Throw, Batted.Passes,
    Pass.Break.Up, Turnover.Worthy.Plays, Turnover.Worthy.Plays.Percentage,
    Big.Time.Throws, Big.Time.Throw.Percentage, Dropped.Passes,
    NFL.Passer.Rating, Average.Depth.of.Targets, Short.of.Sticks.Percentage,
    Percentage.of.Pass.Attempts.passed.First.Down.Markers, Air.Yards.Percentage,
    First.Downs, Play.Action.Percentage, Accuracy.Attempts,
    Accurate.Plus.Percentage, Catchable.Innacurate.Percentage,
    Uncatchable.Innacurage.Percentage, Other.Percentage, Accurate.Throw.Percentage,
    
    # Rushing
    Rush.Grade, Rush.Yards, Yards.per.Attempt.y, Rush.Touchdowns, 
    First.Down.Runs, Fumbles, Fumbles.Lost, Missed.Tackles.on.Runs, 
    Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt, Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt, 
    Scrambles.y, First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage, 
    Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt, Explosive.Runs, Change.of.direction.percentage
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Yards.per.Attempt.Pass = Yards.per.Attempt.x,
    Yards.per.Attempt.Rush = Yards.per.Attempt.y,
    Scrambles = Scrambles.y
  )

# --- Final filter ---
qb_combined_week1_2024 <- qb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB", Dropbacks > 10)

# --- Check ---
cat("Final combined QB dataset dimensions:", dim(qb_combined_week1_2024), "\n")
cat("Unique QBs:", n_distinct(qb_combined_week1_2024$Name), "\n")
table(qb_combined_week1_2024$Conference_Level)

colnames(qb_combined_week1_2024)

# --- View ---
View(qb_combined_week1_2024)
glimpse(qb_combined_week1_2024)

# Week 1 2024 Rushing - RB
# --- Fix data types before joining ---
offensive_Receiving_week1_2024 <- offensive_Receiving_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Conference = as.character(Conference),
    Season = as.integer(Season)
  )

offensive_Rushing_week1_2024 <- offensive_Rushing_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Conference = as.character(Conference),
    Season = as.integer(Season)
  )

# --- Get Offensive Snaps for RBs from summary ---
rb_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "HB") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# --- Combine Rushing, Receiving, and Summary for RBs ---
rb_combined_week1_2024 <- offensive_Rushing_week1_2024 %>%
  left_join(offensive_Receiving_week1_2024, by = c("Name", "Season", "Position")) %>%
  left_join(rb_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# --- Filter for HBs with at least 5 attempts ---
rb_combined_week1_2024 <- rb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "HB", Attempts > 5)

# --- Define conferences ---
p4_conference <- c("ACC", "Big 12", "Big Ten", "SEC", "Pac-12")
g5_conference <- c("MAC", "The American", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)")

# --- Add conference level ---
rb_combined_week1_2024 <- rb_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Conference = coalesce(Conference.x, Conference.y),
    Conference_Level = case_when(
      Conference %in% p4_conference ~ "P4",
      Conference %in% g5_conference ~ "G5",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

View(rb_combined_week1_2024)
colnames(rb_combined_week1_2024)
glimpse(rb_combined_week1_2024)

# Week 1 2024 Receiving - WR (Simplified - like RB approach)

# --- Fix data types before joining ---
offensive_Receiving_week1_2024 <- offensive_Receiving_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Conference = as.character(Conference),
    Season = as.integer(Season),
    Team = Team.Name  # Create Team column from Team.Name
  )

offensive_Rushing_week1_2024 <- offensive_Rushing_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Conference = as.character(Conference),
    Season = as.integer(Season)
  )

# --- Get Offensive Snaps for WRs from summary ---
wr_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "WR") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# --- Combine Receiving, Rushing, and Summary for WRs ---
wr_combined_week1_2024 <- offensive_Receiving_week1_2024 %>%
  left_join(offensive_Rushing_week1_2024, by = c("Name", "Season", "Position")) %>%
  left_join(wr_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# --- Filter for WRs only ---
wr_combined_week1_2024 <- wr_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "WR")

# --- Define conferences ---
p4_conference <- c("ACC", "Big 12", "Big Ten", "SEC", "Pac-12")
g5_conference <- c("MAC", "The American", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)")

# --- Add conference level ---
wr_combined_week1_2024 <- wr_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Conference = coalesce(Conference.x, Conference.y),
    Conference_Level = case_when(
      Conference %in% p4_conference ~ "P4",
      Conference %in% g5_conference ~ "G5",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    Team = coalesce(Team.x, Team.y)
  )

View(wr_combined_week1_2024)
colnames(wr_combined_week1_2024)
glimpse(wr_combined_week1_2024)

# --- Filter to WRs with at least 10 receiving snaps ---
wr_combined_week1_2024 <- wr_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Receiving.Snaps > 10)

# --- Feature Engineering ---
wr_combined_week1_2024 <- wr_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Catch_Rate = Receptions / pmax(Targets, 1),
    Yards_Per_Tgt = Receiving.Yards / pmax(Targets, 1),
    Tgt_Per_Snap = Targets / pmax(Receiving.Snaps, 1)
  )

View(wr_combined_week1_2024)

# Week 1 2024 Receiving - TE
# --- Fix data types before joining ---
offensive_Receiving_week1_2024 <- offensive_Receiving_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Conference = as.character(Conference),
    Season = as.integer(Season)
  )

# --- Get Offensive Snaps for TEs from summary ---
te_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "TE") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# --- Combine Receiving and Summary for TEs ---
te_combined_week1_2024 <- offensive_Receiving_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "TE") %>%
  left_join(te_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# --- Define conferences ---
p4_conference <- c("ACC", "Big 12", "Big Ten", "SEC", "Pac-12")
g5_conference <- c("MAC", "The American", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)")

# --- Add conference level ---
te_combined_week1_2024 <- te_combined_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(
    Conference_Level = case_when(
      Conference %in% p4_conference ~ "P4",
      Conference %in% g5_conference ~ "G5",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  )

# Week 1 2024 Offensive Line
# --- Load OL data ---
ol_week1_2024 <- offensive_line_week1_2024

# --- Get Offensive Snaps for OL from summary ---
ol_summary_snaps <- offensive_summary_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Position %in% c("OT", "OG", "OC", "OL")) %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# --- Join OL data with summary snaps ---
ol_week1_2024 <- ol_week1_2024 %>%
  left_join(ol_summary_snaps, by = c("Name", "Position"))

# --- Define conferences ---
p4_conference <- c("ACC", "Big 12", "Big Ten", "SEC", "Pac-12")
g5_conference <- c("MAC", "The American", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)")

# --- Add conference level ---
ol_week1_2024$Conference_Level <- ifelse(ol_week1_2024$Conference %in% p4_conference, "P4",
                                  ifelse(ol_week1_2024$Conference %in% g5_conference, "G5", "Other"))

# --- Add Offensive.Snaps column (use Offensive.Snaps from join, otherwise use SNAPS) ---
ol_week1_2024 <- ol_week1_2024 %>%
  mutate(Offensive.Snaps = coalesce(Offensive.Snaps, SNAPS))

# --- Filter for at least 30 snaps using Offensive.Snaps ---
ol_week1_2024 <- ol_week1_2024 %>%
  filter(Offensive.Snaps > 10)

# View the result
glimpse(ol_week1_2024)
colnames(ol_week1_2024)
```

    Yards.After.Catch.per.Completion.Percentage, Passing.Touchdowns,

    NFL.Passer.Rating, Average.Depth.of.Targets, Short.of.Sticks.Percentage,
    Percentage.of.Pass.Attempts.passed.First.Down.Markers, Air.Yards.Percentage,

offensive_Passing_week8_2024 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Offense /Week 8/Week 8 Passing 2024.csv")
offensive_Rushing_week8_2024 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Offense /Week 8/Week 8 Rushing 2024.csv")
offensive_Receiving_week8_2024 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Offense /Week 8/Week 8 Receiving 2024.csv")
offensive_line_week8_2024 <- read.csv("/Users/mohammadal-rousan/Desktop/SMU Football Data/Offense/2024/Test Model for Evals/Data/Offense /Week 8/Week 8 Offensive Line 2024.csv")

# --- Week 8 2024 QB Data Preparation ---

cat("Passing dataset columns:\n")
print(colnames(offensive_Passing_week8_2024))

cat("\nRushing dataset columns:\n")
print(colnames(offensive_Rushing_week8_2024))

# --- Passing data ---
passing_clean <- offensive_Passing_week8_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB") %>%
  mutate(
    Conference_Level = case_when(
      Conference %in% c("ACC", "Big 12", "Big Ten", "SEC", "Pac-12") ~ "P4",
      Conference %in% c("MAC", "The American", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)") ~ "G5",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Conference_Level %in% c("P4", "G5"))

# --- Rushing data ---
rushing_clean <- offensive_Rushing_week8_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB") %>%
  select(Name, Position, 
         Rush.Grade, Rush.Yards, Yards.per.Attempt, Rush.Touchdowns, 
         First.Down.Runs, Fumbles, Fumbles.Lost, Missed.Tackles.on.Runs,
         Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt, Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt,
         Scrambles, First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage,
         Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt, Explosive.Runs, Change.of.direction.percentage)

# --- Offensive Summary (Snaps) ---
summary_clean <- offensive_summary_week8_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# --- Join (ONLY Name + Position) ---
qb_combined_week8_2024 <- passing_clean %>%
  left_join(rushing_clean, by = c("Name", "Position")) %>%
  left_join(summary_clean, by = c("Name", "Position")) %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Season, Position, Conference, Conference_Level, Offensive.Snaps,
    
    # Passing
    Pass.Grade, Dropbacks, Attempts, Completion, Completion.Percentage,
    Adjusted.Completion.Percentage, Passing.Yards, 
    Yards.per.Attempt.x, 
    Yards.After.Catch.per.Completion.Percentage, Passing.Touchdowns,
    Interceptions, Sacks, Average.Time.to.Throw, Batted.Passes,
    Pass.Break.Up, Turnover.Worthy.Plays, Turnover.Worthy.Plays.Percentage,
    Big.Time.Throws, Big.Time.Throw.Percentage, Dropped.Passes,
    NFL.Passer.Rating, Average.Depth.of.Targets, Short.of.Sticks.Percentage,
    Percentage.of.Pass.Attempts.passed.First.Down.Markers, Air.Yards.Percentage,
    First.Downs, Play.Action.Percentage, Accuracy.Attempts,
    Accurate.Plus.Percentage, Catchable.Innacurate.Percentage,
    Uncatchable.Innacurage.Percentage, Other.Percentage, Accurate.Throw.Percentage,
    
    # Rushing
    Rush.Grade, Rush.Yards, Yards.per.Attempt.y, Rush.Touchdowns, 
    First.Down.Runs, Fumbles, Fumbles.Lost, Missed.Tackles.on.Runs, 
    Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt, Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt, 
    Scrambles.y, First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage, 
    Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt, Explosive.Runs, Change.of.direction.percentage
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Yards.per.Attempt.Pass = Yards.per.Attempt.x,
    Yards.per.Attempt.Rush = Yards.per.Attempt.y,
    Scrambles = Scrambles.y
  )

# --- Final filter ---
qb_combined_week8_2024 <- qb_combined_week8_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB", Dropbacks > 10)

# --- Check ---
cat("Final combined QB dataset dimensions:", dim(qb_combined_week8_2024), "\n")
cat("Unique QBs:", n_distinct(qb_combined_week8_2024$Name), "\n")
table(qb_combined_week8_2024$Conference_Level)

# --- Week 10 2024 QB Data Preparation ---

cat("Passing dataset columns:\n")

cat("\nRushing dataset columns:\n")

# --- Passing data ---
passing_clean <- offensive_Passing_week10_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB") %>%
  mutate(
    Conference_Level = case_when(
      Conference %in% c("ACC", "Big 12", "Big Ten", "SEC", "Pac-12") ~ "P4",
      Conference %in% c("MAC", "The American", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)") ~ "G5",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(Conference_Level %in% c("P4", "G5"))

# --- Rushing data ---
rushing_clean <- offensive_Rushing_week10_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB") %>%
  select(Name, Position, 
         Rush.Grade, Rush.Yards, Yards.per.Attempt, Rush.Touchdowns, 
         First.Down.Runs, Fumbles, Fumbles.Lost, Missed.Tackles.on.Runs,
         Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt, Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt,
         Scrambles, First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage,
         Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt, Explosive.Runs, Change.of.direction.percentage)

# --- Offensive Summary (Snaps) ---
summary_clean <- offensive_summary_week10_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB") %>%
  select(Name, Position, Offensive.Snaps)

# --- Join (ONLY Name + Position) ---
qb_combined_week10_2024 <- passing_clean %>%
  left_join(rushing_clean, by = c("Name", "Position")) %>%
  left_join(summary_clean, by = c("Name", "Position")) %>%
  select(
    Name, Team, Season, Position, Conference, Conference_Level, Offensive.Snaps,
    
    # Passing
    Pass.Grade, Dropbacks, Attempts, Completion, Completion.Percentage,
    Adjusted.Completion.Percentage, Passing.Yards, 
    Yards.per.Attempt.x, 
    Yards.After.Catch.per.Completion.Percentage, Passing.Touchdowns,
    Interceptions, Sacks, Average.Time.to.Throw, Batted.Passes,
    Pass.Break.Up, Turnover.Worthy.Plays, Turnover.Worthy.Plays.Percentage,
    Big.Time.Throws, Big.Time.Throw.Percentage, Dropped.Passes,
    NFL.Passer.Rating, Average.Depth.of.Targets, Short.of.Sticks.Percentage,
    Percentage.of.Pass.Attempts.passed.First.Down.Markers, Air.Yards.Percentage,
    First.Downs, Play.Action.Percentage, Accuracy.Attempts,
    Accurate.Plus.Percentage, Catchable.Innacurate.Percentage,
    Uncatchable.Innacurage.Percentage, Other.Percentage, Accurate.Throw.Percentage,
    
    # Rushing
    Rush.Grade, Rush.Yards, Yards.per.Attempt.y, Rush.Touchdowns, 
    First.Down.Runs, Fumbles, Fumbles.Lost, Missed.Tackles.on.Runs, 
    Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt, Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt, 
    Scrambles.y, First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage, 
    Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt, Explosive.Runs, Change.of.direction.percentage
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Yards.per.Attempt.Pass = Yards.per.Attempt.x,
    Yards.per.Attempt.Rush = Yards.per.Attempt.y,
    Scrambles = Scrambles.y
  )

# --- Final filter ---
qb_combined_week10_2024 <- qb_combined_week10_2024 %>%
  filter(Position == "QB", Dropbacks > 10)

# --- Check ---

    )
  ) %>%

    Big.Time.Throws, Big.Time.Throw.Percentage, Dropped.Passes,
    NFL.Passer.Rating, Average.Depth.of.Targets, Short.of.Sticks.Percentage,
    Percentage.of.Pass.Attempts.passed.First.Down.Markers, Air.Yards.Percentage,
    First.Downs, Play.Action.Percentage, Accuracy.Attempts,
    Accurate.Plus.Percentage, Catchable.Innacurate.Percentage,
    Uncatchable.Innacurage.Percentage, Other.Percentage, Accurate.Throw.Percentage,
    
    # Rushing
    Rush.Grade, Rush.Yards, Yards.per.Attempt.y, Rush.Touchdowns, 
    First.Down.Runs, Fumbles, Fumbles.Lost, Missed.Tackles.on.Runs, 
    Yards.before.Contact.per.Attempt, Yards.after.Contract.per.Attempt, 
    Scrambles.y, First.down.or.Touchdown.percentage, 
    Missed.Tackles.forced.per.Attempt, Explosive.Runs, Change.of.direction.percentage
  ) %>%

    Yards.per.Attempt.Rush = Yards.per.Attempt.y,
    Scrambles = Scrambles.y
  )

g5_conference <- c("MAC", "The American", "C-USA", "MWC", "Sun Belt", "IND (FBS)")

                                  ifelse(ol_week13_2024$Conference %in% g5_conference, "G5", "Other"))
